notYetAdmitted: This issue is readiness-only: no authored DssBridge or P4-D tests are present. The hashed reproducible shaded archive is the dependency-only layer; the final bridge-containing artifact and P4-D runtime profile must be verified in the subsequent authorized wave.

The official AEAT sample probe confirms DSS structural/basic signature checks and intact references, but its trust result is INDETERMINATE/NO_CERTIFICATE_CHAIN_FOUND. This does not validate a trusted chain, signing-time/usage policy, or supplied CRL/OCSP evidence behavior.

The synthetic signing probe uses a temporary PKCS#12 key and is not an opaque-key isolation test. The bridge key-handle boundary, private-material non-disclosure and concurrent cancellation behavior remain to be implemented and verified in P4-D.

The DSS 6.5 release tag is unsigned. Source identity is separately pinned to the canonical European Commission Git remote, exact commit/tree and source archive hashes; no signed-source-tag claim is made.
The offline build and JaCoCo feasibility probe ran on Ubuntu 24.04 x64. Other declared platform artifacts are hash/signature admitted, but Windows/macOS/arm64 Maven builds are not yet executed.
Competent legal review remains a separate distribution prerequisite; this artifact inventory is not legal approval.
